title: Braselim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Braselim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Braselim is a fire-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Luck (C), Vitality (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Braselim
sections.content:
Location: Inside the Monolith.

Obtained from Inside the Monolith.

sections.title: Is the Braselim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (C), Vitality (B). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
